blocked_attempt.note: raw E1 plays before the block; not part of drives or stats

gaps: statistical-mode field-goal, blocked field-goal and blocked punt outcomes use published 2022-2025 nflverse rates; the block rates are rare and carry wide confidence intervals, and unresolved sampled transitions block the game
blocked-kick returns are recorded in team totals; individual returner statistics are not assigned to the frozen roster
field-goal and try outcomes are drawn from the published nfl_pbp rates (2022-2025, weeks 1-18): each draw is a labelled sample, not the result of a real game
missed-field-goal next-drive spots are sampled from observed transitions; returners and return touchdowns are not reconstructed
safety free kicks are sampled from the observed 2022-2025 safety-kick table (spot and clock only); a safety at a Q1/Q3 end with no clock left still blocks

autonomous penalties currently include typed supported single-foul transitions and live DPI generation; other foul classifiers, multiple-foul rulings, and scoring-play enforcement still fail closed; the statistical path excludes penalties. Onside kicks and exception coin-toss paths remain capability limitations; overtime is modelled for the regular-season period only (Rule 16: 10 minutes, the toss winner receives, the two-minute warning and Article 5(a) are not modelled); a game that takes an unsupported path is blocked or marked incomplete

autonomous field goals and punts now enter the typed ceg-play-2 rules path, but free kicks are touchback-only, punt returns are currently zero yards, and kick coverage, return movement, muffs, blocked kicks and missed-field-goal returns are not generated by live player execution
clock transitions use observed snap-to-snap runoff and explicit stoppages/restart triggers; restart-trigger semantics are an approximation and should be checked against the applicable season rulebook

statistical modes sample offense participants by role and depth rank; autonomous run/pass plays construct both 11-player units, while a complete special-teams roster and substitution model is still absent

blocked_kicks.guard: blocked-kick rates and transitions are sampled from the pinned 2022-2025 nflverse fixture; a sampled penalty, fumble, review, missing recovery, or unresolved endpoint blocks the game

clock_start_stop.guard: the record carries observed snap-to-snap runoff, clock state, stoppage reasons and restart triggers; restart-trigger semantics are a modeled approximation

lineups.guard: participants are labelled sampled_observed_play; no lineup or substitution is modelled

missed_field_goal_return.guard: Rule 11-4-2 exceptions (1) and (2): the receiving start spot is sampled from observed next-drive transitions after missed field goals; a returner, return touchdown and physical return are not reconstructed

onside_kicks.guard: every kickoff is drawn from the observed kickoff pool; no onside kick is drawn

overtime.enforced_by: record status and the scope reason
overtime.guard: a regulation tie with no observed overtime table is blocked as overtime_not_modelled; with the table, overtime drives are observed and Rule 16 decides the winner

penalties.enforced_by: E1 pool exclusion; ceg-play-2 penalty adapter and named transition blocker
penalties.guard: statistical E1 excludes penalty plays; autonomous execution applies typed supported single-foul records and blocks any unsupported foul fact

safety_free_kick.enforced_by: safety-kick source label in validate_game; record blocker when the table is absent
safety_free_kick.guard: a safety free kick is drawn only from the observed 2022-2025 safety-kick table (receiving spot and clock; a kick with no receiving snap before the quarter ends is excluded). Without that table, or at a Q1/Q3 end with no clock left, the game blocks; the ordinary kickoff pool is never used

timeouts.guard: observed timeouts decrement the named team within its three-per-half allowance and are recorded as clock stops; an unavailable caller or exhausted allowance blocks the game

diagnostics.provenance: generated kick placement and live bounded player execution

provisional_rules.effect: the scoring side (or the conceding side, after a safety) kicks off at the start of the next quarter

stats.player_note: Team and player lines are reconciled from the actors and outcomes generated by the autonomous executor.

validation_checks: blocked-kick event types, attempts, classifications and source provenance
game-wide play IDs use one simulation_id and contiguous sequence
recorded half-start kickoffs equal the ledger
every play state carries its drive index, in state_before and state_after
every unsupported rule carries a guard
game points equal drive and free-kick scoring records, touchdown tries included
timeout counts carry across plays and the halftime reset; clocks carry within a drive
each explicit timeout stop agrees with the counts on its play
two-minute warning events independently match clock crossings and restart transitions
unmodelled transitions match the play and kickoff events
active unsupported rules match the game events
valid_full_game only when complete, unblocked, any tie played out in overtime, and no unsupported rule
legal lifecycle completion is distinct from autonomous player execution completeness
